title: Oral Communication for Non-Native Speakers of English - 2nd Edition
description: This book is an essential instructional tool for developing oral communication skills in academic settings, specifically designed for international graduate students, teaching assistants, postdoctoral researchers, and those preparing to enter academia. The second edition introduces dedicated chapters on developing listening, speaking, and pronunciation. Through its wide array of interactive online activities, suitable for both classroom teaching and individual practice, learners can actively develop the skills needed for success in English-speaking academic environments.
authors: Agata Guskaroska - Author / Erik Goodale - Author / Timothy Kochem - Author / Monica Ghosh - Author / Lily Compton - Author / Elena Cotos - Author
